page.layout: One printed page, single text block: running head at top with page number 129 at the top right; then headings and short poems centred, with the poems set in short lines and verse stanzas; no margin notes; no catchword or signature.

main_text.p: Hic Latiis clarus, Graiys ast ille Camœnis, Quis te maiorem sanus vtroque neget?
main_text.head: In Coniugium Impar.
main_text.p: Plaudite, nam vetula iuuenem sors æqua maritat: Ille etenim vetula est dignus, vt hæc vitulo.
main_text.head: IN GALLVM QVI SVBIN-DE RATIONEM ORNANDI capitis mutat.
main_text.p: QVVM toties barbā atq; comā, mutétq; Galeros, Vnū quis Gallo dixerit esse caput?
Beʒanostra placent: vatum celeberrimus ille est Nil mihi nunc tecum linida turba. vale.
main_text.head: IN QVENDAM MA-ledicum.
main_text.p: ME furem vocitas, plagiỹ quoque crime inuris, Et versus quereris surripuisse tuos. Sed me tunde, licet, Cumano peius asello, Si cuiquam vates crederis esse bonus.

page.notes: Mixed printing: the poem titles are set in small capitals. Some letters are doubtful, e.g. "Beʒa" in "Beza nostra" is a printed ligature/initial that I could not read with certainty; "linida" and "mutétq;" are as printed but uncertain. "Galeros" and "Ad Zoilos." are as printed. The head "IN QVENDAM MA-ledicum." is a title split over a line end with a printed hyphen. The stanza ornament and rules are not text and are omitted. Bottom "I. j." is a printed mark kept as a paragraph.
